purpose: Route multi-assay mNGS candidates without replacing the frozen selected-DNA baseline or using physician answers.

strong_analytical_axes.cross_molecule_support: Detected by both DNA and RNA tests.
strong_analytical_axes.repeated_detection: Detected in at least two distinct tests.

actions.retain_baseline: Keep the candidate already present in the frozen selected-DNA baseline.
actions.forward_priority_review: Add to the downstream review queue as an analytically supported candidate.
actions.forward_context_review: Add to downstream review as context; do not promote directly to Picked.
actions.audit_only: Retain in the evidence ledger for manual or literature audit, but do not forward automatically.
actions.hold_not_forwarded: Keep the observation for provenance but exclude it from the downstream candidate queue.

safety_constraints: Do not use physician answers or benchmark hit status.
Do not sum reads across tests.
Do not compare raw reads directly across DNA, RNA, dilution, or protocol conditions.
Cross-test concordance supports analytical reproducibility, not clinical causality.
RNA-only bacterial or fungal signals cannot enter priority review without additional analytical support.
Filtered-only observations never enter the downstream review queue automatically.
Taxonomy family controls routing only; it does not establish pathogenicity.
